title: Kissed Crunchy Thai Apricot Skewers
description: A citrusy and crunchy Thai dish featuring apricots, perfect for a festive occasion, with a macrobiotic-friendly twist. This recipe is broiled to perfection and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, honey, coconut oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the sliced galangal and bruised lemongrass to the bowl and stir to combine.
Thread the apricots onto skewers, leaving a small space between each apricot.
Brush the apricots with the lime juice mixture, making sure they are fully coated.
Broil the skewers for 5 minutes on each side, or until they are caramelized and tender.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil and serve immediately.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
